items.title: He Aha te Barcode? Te Tikanga, te Mahi, me Ōna Momo
items.desc: Kei runga i te nuinga o ngā hua ka hokona e koe he barcode. Me mōhio ki tōna mahi, ki tōna hītori poto, me ngā momo barcode e whakamahia nuitia ana.

items.title: He Aha te QR Code, ā, Ka Pēhea Tōna Mahi?
items.desc: Ka taea e te QR Code te pupuri hono, kuputuhi, tae noa ki ngā raraunga WiFi, ā, ka taea tonu te pānui ahakoa kua pakaru tētahi wāhanga. Anei tōna mahi me ōna painga.

items.title: Te Hanga i te QR Code Koreutu i ngā Hipanga e 3
items.desc: He aratohu whaihua mō te hanga QR Code mō tētahi hono, WiFi, taipitopito whakapā, WhatsApp rānei, kāore he taupānga, kāore he rēhitatanga, me ētahi tohutohu kia māmā ai te matawai.

items.title: Te Rerekētanga o te Barcode 1D me te 2D: Ko Tēhea e Hiahiatia ana e Koe?
items.desc: He barcode te barcode rārangi me te QR Code, engari he rerekē ō rāua mahi. Whakatairitea te nui ka taea te pupuri, te huarahi matawai, me ētahi tauira o te whakamahinga.

items.title: Te Whiwhi i tētahi Barcode Hua EAN-13 mō ngā Pakihi Iti
items.desc: Kei te hiahia koe kia uru ō hua ki ngā toa iti, ki ngā hokomaha rānei? Akona te tikanga o ngā nama EAN-13, te rēhita ki GS1 Indonesia kia whiwhi ai i tētahi tau ōkawa, me te tā i taua barcode.

items.title: Te Hanga i te QR Code WiFi kia Kore ai ngā Manuhiri e Pato i te Kupuhipa
items.desc: Me matawai noa ngā manuhiri i tētahi QR Code kia hono ai ki te WiFi. He pai mō ngā wharekawhe, ngā tari, ngā whare noho, me ngā kāinga. Anei te huarahi hanga me te whakatū.

items.title: Te Rahi me te Taumira Tika o te Barcode mō te Tā
items.desc: He uaua te matawai i te barcode he iti rawa, he pōkākā rānei. Akona te rahi iti rawa, te ture mō te tawhiti matawai, me te taumira whakaahua haumaru mō te tā.

items.title: E 7 ngā Take e Kore ai te Barcode e Matawaitia me te Whakatika
items.desc: Kāore tō barcode, tō QR Code rānei e matawaitia? Tirohia ngā take e whitu e auau ana, mai i te rerekētanga tae tae noa ki te rahi, me te huarahi hei whakatika.

items.title: Te QR Code mō te Tahua Kai o te Wharekai: He Aratohu Katoa
items.desc: Mā te tahua kai matihiko mā te QR Code ka māmā ake mō ngā kiritaki, ka iti iho hoki te utu tā. Anei te huarahi hanga, te whakarite i te tahua kai, me te whakatū ki ngā tēpu.

items.title: He Hoahoa QR Code Auaha ka Taea Tonu te Matawai
items.desc: Ka taea te hanga i te QR Code kia rite ki te manawa, ki te porowhita rānei, kia whai anga, tae hoki. Akona ngā ture kia ātaahua tonu te hoahoa, kia māmā hoki te matawai.
